# PDFly by 3idhMinds

> Free PDF and photo tools, browser-based. Compress a PDF or photo to an exact KB size (built for Indian exam/government portal uploads — SSC, UPSC, Aadhaar, PAN), merge, split, rotate, reorder, crop ID photos, convert images to/from PDF, and generate PDFs from text with 15 templates. Everything runs 100% client-side — files never leave the browser. A REST API exists for developers and renders Latin scripts only; Devanagari, Arabic and Chinese are supported in the browser tools via on-demand font loading.

## Exam & portal upload requirements (primary-sourced)

- [SSC CGL Signature Size 2026](/exam/ssc-signature-size): SSC CGL 2026's own notification gives two different signature dimensions (Section 9.6: 6.0×2.0cm; Annexure: 4.0×2.0cm) — both are stated here. CGL 2026 has no photo upload at all.
- [UPSC Photo & Signature Size](/exam/upsc-photo-signature-size): Photo 20-200KB JPG, signature 20-100KB JPG at 350-500px, certificates 50-300KB PDF. These are minimums as well as maximums — UPSC rejects undersized files too, and validates the filename itself.

## Exact-size tools

- [Compress PDF](/compress-pdf): Compress a PDF to any target size, with presets for 50KB/100KB/200KB/300KB/500KB and larger. Dedicated pages: [/compress-pdf-to-200kb](/compress-pdf-to-200kb), [/compress-pdf-to-100kb](/compress-pdf-to-100kb), [/compress-pdf-to-500kb](/compress-pdf-to-500kb), [/compress-pdf-to-300kb](/compress-pdf-to-300kb), [/compress-pdf-to-50kb](/compress-pdf-to-50kb).
- [Resize Image to KB](/resize-image): Compress a photo or signature to an exact KB target via canvas quality search. Dedicated pages: [/compress-image-to-20kb](/compress-image-to-20kb), [/resize-signature-to-10kb](/resize-signature-to-10kb).
- [ID Photo Crop](/id-photo-crop): Crop and resize a photo to Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID PVC card dimensions at 600 DPI.

## Other browser tools

- [PDF Generator App](/app): Generate PDFs from text using 15 templates.
- [Text to PDF](/text-to-pdf): Feature page for text/HTML to PDF conversion.
- [Image to PDF](/image-to-pdf): Feature page for converting images to PDF.
- [Convert Images](/images-to-pdf): Combine 100+ images into a single PDF.
- [Merge PDF](/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one.
- [Split PDF](/split-pdf): Extract page ranges into separate PDFs.
- [Rotate PDF](/rotate-pdf): Rotate all or selected pages by 90/180/270 degrees.
- [Delete PDF Pages](/delete-pdf-pages): Remove selected pages from a PDF.
- [Reorder PDF Pages](/reorder-pdf-pages): Rearrange page order.
- [PDF to Images](/pdf-to-images): Convert PDF pages to PNG/JPEG.

## REST API endpoints

Base URL: `https://pdfly.3idhmind.in/api`

- `POST /generate-pdf` — Text/HTML to PDF (up to 5 documents per call).
- `POST /images-to-pdf` — Combine images into a PDF.
- `POST /merge-pdf` — Merge multiple PDFs into one.
- `POST /split-pdf` — Split a PDF by page ranges (e.g. `1-3,5,7-9`).
- `POST /compress-pdf` — Rewrite a PDF with metadata stripped and object streams for smaller size.
- `POST /pdf-to-images` — Return each page as a single-page PDF (for raster PNG/JPEG use the browser tool).
- `GET /get-documents` — List or fetch generated documents.

All endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer pdfgen_...` header. Generated files are auto-deleted within 1 hour.

## JavaScript SDK

```ts
import { PDFly } from "@pdfly/sdk";
const pdfly = new PDFly({ apiKey: "pdfgen_..." });
await pdfly.mergePdf({ pdfs: [url1, url2] });
```
